purpose: Teach: 貰い/こんど/赤ん坊/終り/ゴメン/歌わ/ここら/行進

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、お祖母ちゃんから貰い物のお菓子いただいたわ
lines.en: Sho, your grandmother sent sweets home with me.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact announcement. Light, unhurried tempo. The ease of sharing something small and pleasant. Natural smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、こんど、お店遊びに行ってもいい?
lines.en: Mei-sis, can I come to the store with you next time?
lines.style: Bright, hopeful lift. Quick tempo, eager but not frantic. The specific focus of a child who wants one thing. Small, genuine excitement in the question mark.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんとお母さんが、赤ん坊の妹を迎えるのよ
lines.en: Sho, your mom and dad are about to welcome a baby sister.
lines.style: Careful, tender delivery. Slight pause before the main news, like choosing words that matter. Warm but steady — not a secret, not cheerful, just true.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、絵本の終りのお話、教えてよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, will you tell me how the picture book ends?
lines.style: Soft, curious tone. Unhurried pace. The specific focus of a child asking someone he trusts. Genuine wonder, not performance.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お母さんに、ちゃんとゴメンって謝ってね
lines.en: Sho, make sure you apologize properly to your mom, okay?
lines.style: Gentle but clear. Quiet conviction underneath. Not scolding — guiding. The warmth of someone who believes he can do the right thing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お風呂で歌わせてもらってる
lines.en: Mei-sis, Mom lets me sing in the bath.
lines.style: Small, genuine pride in the voice. Quiet tempo. Sharing something that makes him feel safe. The simplicity of a small joy.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、ここらの公園は安心して遊べるわ
lines.en: Sho, the park around here is safe to play in.
lines.style: Calm reassurance. Steady, thoughtful pace. The quiet confidence of someone who has checked and knows it's true. Almost to herself, but meant for him to hear.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、運動会の行進、ぼく頑張ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really tried hard in the school march.
lines.style: Quiet pride and relief. Slight warm lift at the end. The need to be seen for the effort, not just the result. Small voice, solid certainty.
